book.name: Macho
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Macho gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Bamii bamu goone lɛ Jiso ge kiŋgha ki fiɛɛ
Bafalashii bɛ Basadushii ja bo to fɛ Jiso le ki bo moŋ wu, bo mo bo jɛmɛ lɛ wu ge fiɛɛ fì duunyi bvuŋga bvù ja fɛwe.
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Ge doo nyume sege juu seele kibvulɛ yɛɛde lo, bɛŋ du lɛ, ‘Akfuuŋ bude wo joŋ’, nje bɛŋ le bɛŋ yɛŋ lɛ kibvulɛ yɛɛde lo.

Ge doo nyume sege juu saane, kibvulɛ yɛɛde, kimbɛ shugɛ, bɛŋ du lɛ, ‘Nfuŋ lé wu fê abɛŋ’, nje bɛŋ le bɛŋ yɛŋ kibvulɛ yɛɛde kimbɛ shugɛ. Bɛŋ kee ki bɛŋ jîŋɛ kibvulɛ bɛŋ mo bɛŋ kɛɛ no akfuuŋ lé a nyûme, geenɛ bɛŋ ya kee gɛ banjiŋɛ ba mwɛɛ mù kooshi yi kife kinɛ le duunyi gɛ nje la?
Kiŋgogɛ kì befe kinɛ kì le ki chinɛ wa Nyo le ki tu njɛ kwɛse wu kinjikuu, ki goone fiɛɛ fì duunyi bvuŋga bvu jade fɛwe. Gɛ taŋlo ndunyɛ fiɛɛ ki le, fede fi muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo wù Jona gɛ.”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo wu mo wu chinɛ bo le wu ja wu gɛɛne.
Jiso teefɛ booŋ be lɛ bo yɛ̂ne kune gee chi Bafalashii bɛ Basadushii
Booŋ ba Jiso ba ŋgoo doo bo fɛsɛ wuŋ kwege bo yɛŋ lɛ bo le bo daayɛ ki bo jo blɛd.
Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ yɛ̂ne, bɛŋ ka jode kife yi kinshilɛ ki Bafalashii mo ki Basadushii le.”

content: Booŋ be ba ŋgoo mo bo kɛ bo jɛme lɛbolɛbo kune fiɛɛ fiyu, bo duu lɛ, “Wu jɛme kinshilɛ kinɛ nɛ nje besabɛŋ baaŋ to gɛ bɛ blɛd gɛ.”
Jiso kɛɛ fiɛɛ fì bo jɛme kune fi wu mo wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “O oo bamii ba mbɛmɛ wù shige banɛ! Bɛŋ jɛme lɛbɛŋlɛbɛŋ kune blɛd wù bɛŋ baaŋ kɛme gɛ nje la?
Bɛŋ baaŋ mwɛɛ le a yɛŋ gɛ? Gɛ bɛŋ kwaji chefe yi blɛd yishɛŋ yì bamii chi ji banchvuge batɛŋ gɛ? Bimbɛge bì bɛŋ chi baanyɛ chi bee ŋkáa yimiɛɛ?
Gɛ bɛŋ ka kwaji tɛ chefe yi blɛd yì bvusooshwi yì bamii chi ji banchvuge banɛh gɛ? Bɛŋ chi bɛŋ baanyɛ bimbɛge bu ŋkáa yimiɛɛ?
Ge la lɛ bɛŋ baaŋ kɛɛ gɛ lɛ njɛme nyu kune blɛd gɛ? Ŋka njɛme gɛh lɛ bɛŋ jôde kife kune kinshilɛ ki Bafalashii bɛ Basadushii.”

content: No wu jɛme noo bo mo bo kɛɛ lɛ gɛ wu jɛme lɛ bo jode kife nyu kune kinshilɛ kì ba toji blɛd yu gɛ, lɛ wu jɛme nyu kune n'yɛyɛ wu Bafalashii bɛ Basadushii.
Bita chiɛɛyɛ lɛ Jiso le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka
Jiso gɛ̀ gɛɛŋ wu bu kimbe ki woŋ wù Kasalia wu Filibi le, wu ja wu biih booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bamii duu lɛ muh wù jee che le Mwamuh le yɛɛŋ?”

content: Bo chvuu wu le lɛ, “Bamii bamu duu lɛ wo le Joŋ Nlesɛajoo, bamu lɛ le Alaja, bamu duu lɛ wo le Yɛlimia kɛnɛ muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo wumu.”

content.text: Wu biih bo le lɛ, “Bɛŋ duu fiena lɛ nle yɛɛŋ?”

content: Samoŋ Bita chvuu lɛ, “Wo le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka wu le Mwa Nyo, Nyo wù kɛme kinche.”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Samoŋ mwa Jona, Nyo le wu buu wo, nje gɛ finɛ sɛŋe muh wu wuŋ wo le gɛ, sɛŋe chii wù le fɛwe wo le.
Ntu jɛme wo le lɛ wo le Bita,
le yi kimbaaŋ kinɛ le kì nlé ŋgê njooŋ kintaashɛ kaŋ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ yu. Gɛ bvuŋga bvu woŋ wu baŋkfu taŋlo bvu yu bvu ya kintaashɛ kiyu gɛ.
Nlé nnyâ biŋgwenyɛ bi bvunfoŋ bvù fɛwe wo le. Fiɛɛ fì wo le wo kaaŋ fɛkuu fɛnɛ, tu ba le ba kaaŋ wa fɛwe. Fiɛɛ fì wo le wo faanyɛ fɛkuu fɛnɛ, tu ba le ba faanyɛ wa fɛwe.”

content: No Jiso jɛmɛ noo, wu mo wu chiisɛ lo booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ keefɛ bo môŋ bo sɛ̂ɛŋ muh le lɛ wu le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka gɛ.
Jiso jɛmɛ kune kfuu chi kwe yì wu le wu ge wu kwe

Kɛge yi kife kɛɛ le, Jiso mo wu kɛ wu duunyi booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ wu kɛme ki wu gɛ̂ɛŋ gɛh Yɛlusalɛm. Wu gɛɛŋ wu yɛŋ baŋgɛ ba duude chiaaŋ yi bamii ba sage woŋ bɛ bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ mo bamii ba duunyi banchi ba Nyo. Bo mo bo yuuyɛ wu, aju atade wu kaasɛ wu bu yi kwe le.
Bita mo wu jo wu bɛ wu kɛŋsɛ. Wu mo wu kɛ wu wame wu yi fiɛɛ fiyu le, wu duu lɛ, “Tada, Nyo ŋgaŋsɛ. Gɛ finɛ fiɛɛ nyu fi yu fi kooshɛ bɛ wo gɛ.”
Jiso kaasɛ ye wu jɛmɛ Bita le lɛ,

content.text: “Ja a mɛ jiŋ Sataŋ! Wo jeese lo mɛ nje gɛ wo lɛme yi kimbe ki Nyo le gɛ. Wo lɛme nyu yi ki muh wu wuŋ le.”

content: No Jiso jɛme noo, wu mo wu jɛmɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ,

content.text: “Muh nɛ goone ki wù nyu muh waŋ wu ŋgoo, tu wù kɛme ki wu fâŋ kikwɛɛ ke, wu tuu kintaaŋ ke wu bii mɛne.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ muh wu baji kinche ke lé wu lɛ̂sɛ lo ki. Geenɛ muh wu le wu lɛsɛ kinche ke nje mɛ, lé wu gê wù kɛme kinche.
Nɛ ba banyi woŋ kfunɛ wuchii, ba nya muh le lɛ wu ji, wu to wu lɛsɛ kinche ke, mbe we nyume la? Noo, fiɛɛ le yu fì taŋlo muh suuŋ kiyo ke yu le?
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ muh wù jee che le Mwamuh lé wu gê wu tô bɛ banchɛndaa be a bvukugɛ bvu chiji le, wu mo wu laŋɛ muh wuchii yi fiɛɛ fì muh le wu ge le.
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ bamii bamu lɛme fɛnɛ gɛ bo nyu bo to bo yu wuŋ wu kwe gɛ, fuge njɛ bo yɛŋ muh wu jee che le Mwamuh too bɛ bvunfoŋ bwe gɛ.”

footnotes.text: Jee chi Bita chinɛ le lɛ, “Tɛdɛ”.
